name: Praise Helix
description: Twitch Plays Pokemon chaos on top of your own buttons, on all eleven games, going nearly everywhere you can (bag, party, PC, shops, NPCs): a random press every 0.9 s, 0.5 s or 0.3 s, and at HELIX your own inputs join a 0.9-second queue. It never presses A on RELEASE, never saves your game, stays out of settings, the Mod Manager and mod START rows, and holding START+SELECT turns it off.
